== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=tg-03-city-of-light|Gloria is a painted wooden doll belonging to [[Simon]]. She possesses a mental voice that sounds as though it is traveling through a [[wind]]-filled tunnel. Characterized by an ornate bun of white hair secured with gold [[chains]], she wears a pink, fluffy dress decorated with golden ornaments. Gloria is capable of communicating telepathically, expressing a wide range of emotions including pride, sympathy, disgust, and frustration. She has expressed opinions on the appearance of others and has commented on the actions of various individuals, including mentions of [[Simon]], [[Indirial]], and the [[Eldest]].}}

== City of Light ==
{{spoiler|book=tg-03-city-of-light|Gloria is a doll characterized by her white hair styled in an ornate bun and a painted wooden face. She serves as a translator for [[Leah]] by communicating with [[Simon]] through a mental voice that resembles whispering [[wind]] echoing through a long tunnel. During the events of the story, her physical form sustains significant damage, leaving her chest cracked along with her torn dress and hair. She was eventually found sitting nearby in this ruined state.}}
